shadows.name: fab
shadows.purpose: High elevation for floating action buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Used for main calls to action like booking a table.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 36px; background: #7A4B56; color: #F3F4F6; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 150ms, transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; min-height: 54px; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9D6270; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(122, 75, 86, 0.4); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Used for alternative actions like viewing the menu.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 15px 34px; border: 1px solid rgba(243, 244, 246, 0.2); color: #F3F4F6; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: border-color 150ms, background 150ms, transform 150ms; min-height: 54px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(243, 244, 246, 0.5); background: rgba(243, 244, 246, 0.05); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Tab Button
components.description: Used in the menu section to toggle categories.
components.css: .ds-tab-btn { position: relative; padding: 14px 22px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9CA3AF; transition: color 150ms; white-space: nowrap; min-height: 48px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-btn::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -1px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: #7A4B56; transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-tab-btn:hover { color: #BCC0CA; } .ds-tab-btn.active { color: #F3F4F6; } .ds-tab-btn.active::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

narrative.overview: Minimalist, precise, and understated. The design should recede and let the culinary craft and photography stand out. The dark, layered aesthetic conveys a sense of premium authenticity, reserving warmth for the photography and carefully chosen accents.
keyCharacteristics: Elegant serif typography for impact and display.
Utilitarian sans-serif for legible interface elements.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Text on `bg-primary` must always be `#F3F4F6` (Primary) or `#BCC0CA` (Secondary) for legibility. Muted text should only be used on labels or large text.

dos: Do allow generous whitespace between sections to let the design breathe.
Do use the display serif exclusively for large headers, never for body copy or small UI elements.
Do rely on photography as the primary source of color on the page.
donts: Don't use large border radii. Keep corners sharp and deliberate (3px–6px max).
Don't overuse the primary accent color. It should be reserved for actionable items or very subtle underlines.
Don't use solid opaque backgrounds for floating headers; rely on the blur effect to show depth.
